SMOKY CHICKPEA STEW
SERVES 4

A pot that tastes as if it took all afternoon, from a short list of
pantry tins and one good spoon of paprika.

2 tablespoons olive oil
1 large yellow onion, peeled and
chopped
3 garlic cloves, finely
minced
1 teaspoon smoked paprika
1 (28-ounce) can whole
tomatoes, drained and thinly
sliced
2 (15-ounce) cans
chickpeas, rinsed
1 cup vegetable stock
Ya cup finely
chopped flat-leaf parsley
1 bag shredded
mozzarella, for the top
salt and pepper to taste
pinch of sugar

1. Warm the oil in a wide pot and soften the onion
for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika and stir
for a minute more.
2. Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, stock and sugar.
Simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
3. Season, scatter with the parsley and cheese, and
serve from the pot.
